## Accessibility Issue: Checkout button low contrast (WCAG 1.4.3)

**URL:** https://shop.example.test/checkout
**XPath:** //*[@id="checkout"]/button
**Full DOM path:** html/body/main/button.checkout
**WCAG SC:** 1.4.3 — Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA)
**Rule:** axe — color-contrast
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Frequency:** 1 instance on this page

### HTML Snippet

```html
<button class="checkout">Buy</button>
```

### Description

The checkout button text fails the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to https://shop.example.test/checkout
2. Inspect the button's contrast ratio

### Expected Behaviour

Text meets 4.5:1 contrast.

### Actual Behaviour

Text contrast measures 2.1:1. Both engines flagged this and it was confirmed by axe and wave.
